desc: Boys 4+ still seated in their black hull at the dock, four rowers grinning and holding up bronze NEIRA medals on blue ribbons; coach and an adult kneeling behind on yellow dock matting. Professional row2k frame.

Fourteen novice girls plus a coach in a long line on gravel, all holding a single long black oar horizontally across the frame. Behind them the Cambridge Boat Club: white clapboard, red geranium window boxes, an open bay glowing warm with racked shells inside, upper deck with people.

Nine male rowers arm-in-arm on a wide wooden dock in white MIT unisuits with red block T. Behind them the Charles, dramatic storm clouds, the Boston skyline and a crew sitting in a shell; oars laid across the dock in the foreground.

About twelve senior girls in a line on a wooden dock, each wearing the sweatshirt of the college she committed to (Wisconsin, Colby, Bates, Cornell, Middlebury, MIT, Macalester, Washington, Durham). River and green tree line behind.
Five girls shoulder-to-shoulder on a gravel path at a regatta site, each wearing a NEIRA silver medal on a blue lanyard, in black CRLS unisuits. Blurred regatta tents and tall green trees behind.
Twelve people arm-in-arm on grass before a white USRowing step-and-repeat banner: ten athletes in black CRLS unisuits wearing bronze medals, flanked by two coaches in grey CRLS CREW tees.

Six girls (five standing, one in a wheelchair) posed at the Nathan Benderson Park gold-mosaic monument sign with the USRowing Youth National Championships 2026 Sarasota logo. Palm trees and bright blue sky behind.

Cambridge Boat Club president John Lambert mid-speech, arms open, holding papers, addressing Fall Orientation inside the boathouse: white beadboard walls hung with framed watercolours, warm wooden floor, a Concept2 BikeErg in the foreground.
